<a name="ColorAmber600"></a>ANSI True Color escapes based on Tailwind CSS

```go [cli.go]
const (
    ColorAmber600   = "\033[38;2;217;119;6m"   // <warn>
    ColorEmerald600 = "\033[38;2;5;150;105m"   // <success>
    ColorBlue600    = "\033[38;2;37;99;235m"   // <info>
    ColorRed600     = "\033[38;2;220;38;38m"   // <error>
    ColorGray500    = "\033[38;2;107;114;128m" // <debug>
    ColorReset      = "\033[0m"
)
```

<a name="Command"></a>
## type [Command](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/console/cli/registry.go#L14-L26>)

Command represents an Artisan\-like headless command that can be executed from the CLI.

```go [registry.go]
type Command interface {
    // Name returns the CLI command name (e.g., "help", "version")
    Name() string

    // Description returns a short description of what the command does
    Description() string

    // DefineFlags allows the command to register custom CLI flags
    DefineFlags(_ *flag.FlagSet)

    // Execute runs the command logic. It receives the cli context.
    Execute(ctx *Context, args []string) error
}
```

<a name="CommandFunc"></a>
## type [CommandFunc](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/console/cli/registry.go#L32>)

CommandFunc is the signature for the actual command execution logic.

```go [registry.go]
type CommandFunc func(ctx *Context, args []string) error
```

<a name="Registry.Route"></a>
### func \(\*Registry\) [Route](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/console/cli/registry.go#L83>)

```go [registry.go]
func (r *Registry) Route(ctx *Context, args []string) (bool, error)
```

Route checks args and executes the appropriate command. Returns true if a command was executed, false if no command was present. It receives a cli.Context which supports UI mounting.
